pages.text: Structure Blocks are blocks which can eventually evolve to something greater. They evolve gaining Kill Points, which they can get by entering into contact with a Spore creature that itself got Kill Points. Structures Blocks can also be given Kill Points by a nearby Mound. Structure Blocks are placed by level 4 Mounds, and $(l)each Mound can only place a structure block once in its life$(). Spore creatures may get Kill Points in various ways, most notably by killing other creatures or being spawned by an Overcharged Scent.

$(l)Right click a Structure Block to see its amount of stored Kill Points.$()$(br2)Keep in mind however Spore creatures can also spend Kill Points on themselves to get status effects.$(br2)Read about how structure blocks work in the two next pages.

The $(l)Reconstructed Mind$() is the most dangerous Structure Block. Can evolve into a Proto-Hivemind, enabling the advanced stage of the Spore Infestation. Do not let this happen before you are ready. More information can be found in the $(l:proto)Proto-Hivemind chapter$(/l). This block may be invisible from a distance of more than 30 blocks.$(br2)If a Proto-Hivemind already exists in less than 300 blocks from the Reconstructed Mind, it will evolve into an Outpost Watcher instead.

The Biomass Lump evolves into a Biomass Tower once it obtains 2 Kill Points. A Biomass Tower is a source of Biomass, but also contains an Organite Block, which will drop resources if mined by a player. The Organite Block will inflict negative status effects to non-Spore creatures in its vicinity.
